case.transcript: Hi, I'm calling about my mother, she's 72. She uses the Cardiolex autoinjector and yesterday the pen jammed halfway through the injection. She ended up with a big bruise, a hematoma on her thigh where she injected. Lot number is CX4471. I still have the pen if you need it back.

expected.note: Multi-intent: device complaint + listed non-serious AE

case.transcript: Hello, I'm a community pharmacist. Can Glucavant tablets be split or crushed for a patient who has trouble swallowing? Please reply to this email. Thanks, R. Patel, PharmD

This is Dr. Alvarez, hepatology. I have a 45-year-old male patient on Neurafen XR for about six weeks who was admitted to our hospital on September 28 with acute liver injury, ALT over 900. We've stopped the drug. I'm reporting this as a possible reaction.

My name is Tom, I'm 66. I've been on Glucavant for a year. Last week I got really sick and was admitted to the hospital for three days with lactic acidosis. The doctors think it was the Glucavant. I started feeling bad on September 24.
Product: Glucavant tablets. Lot: GV-2209-B. Issue: Several tablets in my new bottle are discolored with brown spots and a couple are cracked. I haven't taken any of them. I can send the bottle back.
someone I know got a rash after starting neurafen. just thought you should know. bye

expected.note: Invalid ICSR (no identifiable patient/reporter) must still reach PV for follow-up

case.transcript: I'm a 58 year old woman taking Glucavant. Yesterday I got so dizzy I nearly fainted and my husband drove me to the ER. They kept me a few hours and sent me home. It was really scary.

expected.note: Borderline seriousness: ER visit without admission

case.transcript: Nurse practitioner calling. Is there any interaction between Neurafen XR and oral contraceptives? Also, my patient, a 31 year old woman, has had persistent nausea since starting Neurafen XR two weeks ago.

case.transcript: I'm 52, male. I've been taking Glucavant exactly as prescribed for three months and my blood sugars are still over 250 every morning. It just doesn't seem to be working.

expected.note: Lack of effect is an AE
